scope: Original rightmost editor document-pane experiment. The later full-admin rollout is recorded separately below.

fullAdminRollout.note: The workbench control treatment covers the full admin and all document editors. All 72 canonical admin boards were regenerated in place on 2026-09-16 and passed an editable top-level structure audit; Paper screenshot export remains unavailable. Earlier prototype observations below remain historical records.

workbenchPrototype.choiceRefinement: User-requested: remove checkmarks and nested borders; symmetric centered labels, a single outer boundary, tinted selection and keyboard focus retained. Touch and arrow-key checks pass in both themes.

browserChecks.listboxRegression: passed: touch/pointer, keyboard, Escape, Tab, outside click at 390px and 1440px
browserChecks.compoundPriceField: phone screenshot feedback corrected: one outer border and one focus outline; tested in both themes and all matrix widths
browserChecks.galleryKeyboardReorder: pre-existing failure reproduced with and without new styling; not fixed
